verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs markets the ability to 'monitor' deployed agents, and its documented agent analysis covers success evaluation and sentiment, but only across completed conversations. Nothing shows real-time observation of live calls or any alerting mechanism. missing for 10: live in-call monitoring, alerting on agent misbehavior, error-rate tracking and spike alerts, production observability dashboards or metrics, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike

citations.quote: Configure, deploy and monitor natural, human-sounding agents in 70+ languages
Success evaluation: Define custom criteria to assess conversation quality, goal achievement, and customer satisfaction
Sentiment analysis: Understand user sentiment across completed conversations
